title: **Pending injected context retains an Activation** — settlement conservatively treats every Inbox occurrence as unfinished. Context parked after the Agent becomes idle keeps the child and its live ancestors resident until a waking delivery ...

attrs.text: **Pending injected context retains an Activation** — settlement conservatively treats every Inbox occurrence as unfinished. Context parked after the Agent becomes idle keeps the child and its live ancestors resident until a waking delivery claims it, a queue mutation removes it, or manager teardown discards it. Host completion joins active work, pending child creation, and resource cleanup, but does not wait for a subtree containing only idle parked inboxes; it neither completes those activation results nor discards their messages.
